rootCause: The atomic policy update contained a synthetic root policy, but generated child mutations (receipts, portfolio and activity) were not all marked/identified as synthetic, so the strict Preview backend rejected the batch.
fix: In the authorized Preview write adapter only, detect a b4003qa/b3004qa synthetic policy root; propagate __syntheticQa only to mutations linked to that synthetic lineage and normalize derived insert IDs for activity/vehicle so every target remains synthetic. Production routing is unchanged.
